role.altitude: The tailor keeps talking with the customer, measuring, choosing style and fabric and fitting; only redrawing base patterns from scratch shrinks a little.
skills_to_grow: Keeping a digital library of base patterns
role.ambitious_version: A tailor who keeps each regular customer's adjusted pattern on file and makes a new garment without starting over.

tasks.short: Discuss the design with the customer, take measurements, develop, copy or adapt designs for garments, design patterns to fit measurements and check the fit on the customer.

steps.what: Tailor discusses the garment design with the customer
Tailor develops or adapts designs for garments: style, construction and fabric
Tailor designs patterns to fit the measurements
Tailor checks the fit on the customer and adjusts the pattern

tasks.design: The tailor keeps their own base patterns in pattern software, which adjusts a base to the entered measurements and prints it, instead of drafting each pattern on paper from scratch. Talking with the customer, measuring, choosing style and fabric and fitting stay fully by hand.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patterns were drafted on paper for each customer.
tasks.enabler_now: Pattern software with base patterns adjusted to measurements.
tasks.still_hard: Bodies that standard adjustments do not fit.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing how a fabric will hang on this person.

evidence.claim: Pattern software can adjust a base pattern to entered measurements.

assumptions: Boundary: designing and patterning a garment; cutting and sewing are outside.
Input contract for s4: the tailor's base patterns digitised once; shops without a plotter print on tiled paper.

Conversation, measuring, design and fitting keep their full time. s4 keeps 80 because the software adjusts the base pattern and the tailor still enters the measurements and adapts the pattern to the design.
unknowns: Share of garments that start from a base pattern.

incremental.description: Tailor keeps the base pattern library current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most garments are one-off designs or bodies the standard adjustment does not fit, so patterns are still drafted from scratch (1.0); high: repeat customers and standard styles (5.5).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
